accessibility.contrast_guarantee: All body copy meets >4.5:1 contrast against light grey/white background. Navy surfaces have stark white copy (>12:1).
accessibility.aria_labels: All form controls have associated labels and aria-describedby for validation errors. Buttons have clear accessible text.
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full tab and enter/space support across modals, PIN pad, tabs, and interactive enquiry forms.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Design Archetype: Corporate Industrial + Compliance Trust. Crisp, authoritative, highly structured. Zero 'bouncy cartoon' visuals.
Palette: Navy Blue (#0F2444) for authority and structure, Industrial Orange (#EA580C) for action and energy, Light Slate/White for readability.
Ensure both Employer Funnel ('Hire Workforce / Request RFQ') and Candidate Funnel ('Worker Registration / Find Jobs') are crystal clear and easy to navigate.

The PIN-protected Admin dashboard must be fully interactive with functional in-memory state or backend endpoints, allowing reviewing submitted registrations, managing client inquiries, and creating/toggling job postings.
All forms (Company RFQ and Worker Registration) must provide instant visual feedback with Sonner toasts and validate mandatory inputs.
Include every data-testid specified in testing attributes across navbar, forms, buttons, and admin actions.
